page.overview:
Who is Genli?

After the "" has been completed, can find at . She is angry that and the rest of her sisters have not arrived for their rehearsal. They are supposed to perform for , the elder of , but thinks are not prepared to do so.

Since is a scary , asks him to find her sisters and remind them of rehearsal. However, she thinks will be difficult, as she is probably in the demanding . This begins the "" .

Back in , can be found in the , where she is begging for . She refuses to practice with until she gets it. The rest of her sisters have already left to gather ingredients for her, though she did not expect them to listen to her. does not want to practice her singing, but she still does want . She wonders what is taking them so long, as they were only supposed to go to .

When speaks to , , and , they will each give him one ingredient on the condition he makes for . In the , can smell if has it on him. She frantically asks to let her have it. She is very excited when allows her to have some, and she eats it immediately.
